title: .sylviapack manifest
description: sylviapack/manifest.json, the first entry of a .sylviapack v1 wired-transfer bundle (plan 8.5, 16.4; ADR-0010). The container is a single-volume ZIP (ZIP64 when needed) laid out back to back with no archive comment: entry 1 is this manifest (stored), entry 2 is sylviapack/manifest.sha256 (stored, exactly 65 bytes: the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the manifest entry's bytes followed by a line feed), then one entry content/<path> per file in manifest order. Audio, EPUB, PDF and cover entries are stored (method 0); text and Markdown may be deflated (method 8). Entries are regular, non-executable files only. Rules the schema cannot express and readers must enforce: paths are Unicode NFC and unique after case folding and normalization, and no path is also a folder of another; total_size is the sum of size; group_id on a file names a group in groups; every audio member of an audiobook group has a unique order >= 1, and only audio and cover files belong to an audiobook group; order appears only with group_id; the per-kind size limits and the 10,000-entry limit (manifest entries included). The manifest never contains a credential, token or device identifier.

generator.description: The program that wrote the bundle (for diagnostics only).

total_size.description: Sum of every file's size, in bytes.

path.description: Relative path under content/ in the archive: 1 to 15 components separated by '/', none empty, '.' or '..', no leading '/', no backslash, colon or control character; at most 512 UTF-8 bytes in total and 255 per component (readers check bytes). The archive entry name is content/ followed by this path, so it has at most 16 components and 520 bytes. The 512-byte bound keeps an extracted file's full path (a container directory of about 180 to 250 bytes plus this path) below PATH_MAX (1024 bytes).

size.description: Uncompressed size in bytes; must equal the archive entry's sizes and the bytes produced.

order.description: 1-based member order inside an audiobook group.

kind.description: audiobook: one logical audiobook of ordered audio members (plan 8.3). publication: a single EPUB, PDF, text or Markdown work with optional cover.

member_order_basis.description: How the member order was decided: embedded disc/track tags, natural file-name order, or confirmed by the user (plan 8.3).
